title: Homology of Rook-Brauer Algebras and Motzkin Algebras
content: Using the technique of inductive resolution introduced by Hepworth, Patzt and Boyd, we prove that the homology of Rook-Brauer Algebra, interpreted as appropriate Tor-group, is isomorphic to that of symmetric group for all degrees under the assumption that $\epsilon$ in $R$ is invertible; furthermore, we also prove the homology of the Motzkin algebras vanishes in positive degrees under the same assumption.  These results thereby establish homological stability of both algebras.
